description: Source code for ExecutorFailureTracker class in Apache Spark, responsible for tracking executor failures per host and overall, including configuration for maximum failures.

classes.name: ExecutorFailureTracker
classes.description: Tracks executor failures for each host and overall, with configurable validity interval.

methods.name: updateAndCountFailures
methods.description: Removes outdated failure timestamps and returns the current count of failures.

methods.name: numFailedExecutors
methods.description: Returns the total number of failed executors within the validity interval.

methods.name: registerFailureOnHost
methods.description: Registers a failure for a specific host at the current time.

methods.name: registerExecutorFailure
methods.description: Registers a failure for any executor at the current time.

methods.name: numFailuresOnHost
methods.description: Returns the number of failures for a specific host within the validity interval.
